# Introduction to H5P fixture

User-supplied presentation and reference exports used to verify slide rendering
and H5P packaging. Files were moved and renamed without changing their contents.

| File | Original name | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source.pptx` | `Introduction to H5P.pptx` | Input presentation: seven visible slides, 16:9 aspect ratio. |
| `reference/powerpoint.pdf` | `Introduction to H5P.pdf` | User-supplied PowerPoint PDF export: seven pages. |
| `reference/powerpoint_images/slide_01.png` through `slide_07.png` | `Introduction to H5P/Slide1.png` through `Slide7.png` | User-supplied PowerPoint image exports in slide order, each 720×405 pixels. |

The PowerPoint version and export settings beyond the observed image dimensions
were not recorded. These exports are visual references, not outputs generated by
the converter. Compare content, slide order, clipping, and layout; LibreOffice
and PowerPoint are not expected to produce identical pixels.

Tests derive hidden-slide, all-hidden, reordered-slide, and 4:3 variants from
temporary copies of the source deck. Keep derived presentations, generated H5P
archives, comparison sheets, and temporary PDFs out of this fixture directory.
